,CAST(CASE WHEN GAM.ACCT_CRNCY_CODE = 'PHP' THEN EAB.VALUE_DATE_BAL
    ELSE EAB.VALUE_DATE_BAL * BCC.ConversionRate
    END AS numeric(22,4)) RELATIONSHIP_EXPOSURE_PHP
,0 AS BILLED_AMOUNT_PHP
,CAST(CASE WHEN GAM.ACCT_CRNCY_CODE = 'PHP' THEN GAM.SANCT_LIM
    ELSE GAM.SANCT_LIM * BCC.ConversionRate
    END AS numeric(22,4)) CREDIT_LIMIT_PHP
,CAST(CASE WHEN GAM.ACCT_CRNCY_CODE = 'PHP' THEN 1
    ELSE BCC.ConversionRate
    END AS numeric(22,4)) CONVERSION_RATE


FROM (SELECT * FROM D360.STG_EDS_GLD_GENACCTMASTTABLE WHERE H = 'D') GAM
LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM D360.STG_EDS_GLD_EODACCTBALTABLE WHERE H = 'D') EAB 
ON GAM.ACID = EAB.ACID AND GAM.BANK_ID = EAB.BANK_ID
AND LEFT(RIGHT(GAM.FILE_NAME, 12), 8) = LEFT(RIGHT(EAB.FILE_NAME, 12), 8)
LEFT JOIN  (SELECT * FROM bnkm.currencyconversion where ConvertToCurrencyId = 'PHP' AND RateId = 'REV' )  BCC ON 
LEFT(RIGHT(GAM.FILE_NAME, 12), 8) = BCC.CurrencyConversionTimestamp
AND GAM.BANK_ID = BCC.FinancialInstitutionId
AND GAM.ACCT_CRNCY_CODE = BCC.ConvertFromCurrencyId
